   "source": [
    "from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor\n",
    "from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "jm = pd.read_excel(\"/Users/jhessiffer/Downloads/Book2.xlsx\")\n",
    "x =jm[['Operator_experience','Shift_time','Downtime','Machine_efficiency','Task_complexity','Product_type','Material_quality',\n",
    "      'Work_environment','Number_of_tasks','Motivation_index']]\n",
    "y = jm['Units_produced']\n",
    "x = np.array(x, dtype=object) \n",
    "le4 = LabelEncoder()\n",
    "le5 = LabelEncoder()\n",
    "le7 = LabelEncoder()\n",
    "x[:, 4] = le4.fit_transform(x[:, 4])\n",
    "x[:, 5] = le5.fit_transform(x[:, 5])\n",
    "x[:, 7] = le7.fit_transform(x[:, 7])\n",
    "x = x.astype(float)\n",
    "model = DecisionTreeRegressor()\n",
    "model.fit(x, y)\n",
    "new_input = [2, 12, 0.49, 89.49, 'High', 'TypeA', 92.77, 'Hot', 7, 61.66]\n",
    "new_input[4] = le4.transform([new_input[4]])[0]\n",
    "new_input[5] = le5.transform([new_input[5]])[0]\n",
    "new_input[7] = le7.transform([new_input[7]])[0]\n",
    "prediction = model.predict([new_input])\n",
    "print(\"Prediction:\", prediction[0])"
   ]
  },
